caseName: American Party of Texas v. White
caseNameFull: American Party of Texas v. White, Secretary of State of Texas

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. W. D. Tex. [Probable jurisdiction noted, sub nom. American Party of Texas v. Bullock, 410 U. S. 965.] Motion of appellant Dunn for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted only to the extent that a typewritten brief may be filed.
